hypothesis: One bounded transitive round and a separate direct-recursion pass miss deeper readers and mutually recursive borrowed parameters. A shrinking-mask worklist can remove retains while avoiding repeated whole-program rounds.
scope: RC ownership optimization, not the language safety borrow checker. No wasm-gc or arena-lifetime change.
revision_note: The controlled comparisons isolate the borrow worklist on #2791. After measurement, contract comments were corrected, unused round-0 oracle state was removed, and main PRs #2790/#2794 were integrated. Rebased artifacts were regenerated and tested separately; the timing deltas do not measure those additional changes.

regression.red: An eight-wrapper chain classified only its last two functions as borrowed: [0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1]. The candidate returns eight borrowed masks in both declaration orders.
cases: owned return propagated through argument permutations
temporary argument propagated through a recursive component
outer parameter callee shadows including labeled and optional names
linked module exclusions and value uses
runtime preservation through recursive calls and owned callbacks

interpretation: Target RC instructions intentionally differ across compiler implementations. Every target is stable within a compiler across cold/warm and rounds, and compiler-runtime bump/RC variants agree for each implementation. Generated closure tests and CLI-compiled ownership programs are executed separately. Heap pointer, linear capacity and peak RSS are distinct metrics; shared-machine noise and A/A controls limit wall-time conclusions.
